summary: MGT Intermediate, LLC argues against sunset or narrowing of the E‑Rate program, supports continued Category Two funding, calls for modernization of managed services and cybersecurity, urges documentation‑based price reviews, proposes narrowing the consultant definition, opposes caps on reseller margins, and insists Head Start and Pre‑K programs remain eligible. MGT, a vendor/consultant, argues that the E‑Rate program should not be sunset or narrowed, supports continued Category Two funding, and proposes cost‑effective reforms such as additional provider documentation and strengthened managed services and cybersecurity. The commenter urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen E‑Rate Category Two services, especially Managed Internal Broadband Services (MIBS), while streamlining the program and preventing fraud. They oppose drastic cuts to Category Two funding and support expanding cybersecurity and AI‑related services. MGT Intermediate, LLC proposes several changes to the E‑Rate program, including expanding cybersecurity eligibility, clarifying support for non‑instructional buildings, updating firewall definitions, and streamlining administrative forms.
